existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: The resource identity is stable, but the local contact model is breaking: R4 `telecom` is removed, R6 `contact` uses `ExtendedContactDetail`, and R6 forbids `home` use in OrganizationAffiliation contacts. The largest uncertainty is the absence of an official cross-version map for contact migration.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration centers on contact transformation. R4 `telecom: ContactPoint[]` can usually map to R6 `contact[].telecom[]`, but systems must decide grouping, summary behavior, and how to handle `home` contact uses. R6→R4 projection is lossy for `contact.purpose`, `contact.name`, `contact.address`, `contact.organization`, and `contact.period` unless extensions or external metadata are used. Other local elements preserve cardinality, types, and reference targets.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for structural changes because both R4 and R6 StructureDefinitions are present and have the same canonical identity. Confidence is medium for migration policy and semantic intent because no official diff, change note, or cross-version ConceptMap/StructureMap was available. Terminology confidence is adequate for packaged compose comparisons, but not for live SNOMED expansion details.
